name: spreadsheetAddDataValidationRule
description: Adds a data validation rule that restricts what can be entered in a range of cells.

params.name: rule
params.description: Struct describing the rule. Keys: validationType (integer, double, list, date or text_length), regions (array of structs with startRow, startColumn, endRow, endColumn), value, operator (greater_than, less_than, greater_or_equal, less_or_equal, equal, not_equal, between, not_between), minValue, maxValue, alertTitle, alertText, cellSelectTitle, cellSelectText.
